nodes.text: 🚨 Health Alert: HMPV Outbreak in China 📷After COVID-19, another virus is spreading—Human metapneumovirus (HMPV). Cases are surging, especially in children, while China is once again hiding the severity. 📷 Symptoms: Cough, fever, fatigue 📷 No specific treatment 📷
